## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (changes existing behavior or public API)
- [ ] New or changed engine adapter
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Refactoring, tests, CI or tooling (no user-facing change)

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests that cover this change
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes
- [ ] I updated the docs (README, `docs/`, docstrings) where needed
- [ ] I added an entry under "Unreleased" in `CHANGELOG.md` (if user-facing)
- [ ] All commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, [DCO](https://developercertificate.org/))
- [ ] This change needs GPU tests (vLLM / CUDA paths); I ran `scripts/gpu_check.sh`, or a maintainer will
